title: Build Stunning Websites With Claude Code Using This Setup
description:
Want Claude Code to build professional websites with real animations,
glassmorphism, gradients and cinematic layouts?

Here's the exact two step setup that changes everything.

Step 1 — UIUXPRO MAX Skill 👇
Search UIUXPRO MAX on GitHub — this gives Claude Code instant access 
to 50+ UI styles, 21 color palettes and 50 font pairings. 
Copy the URL and paste into Claude Code — say install this skill.

Step 2 — 21st.dev Magic MCP Server 👇
Head to 21st.dev and grab their magic MCP server command.
Paste into Claude Code — say install this MCP server.

Now when you ask Claude to build — the output includes
proper animations, glassmorphism, gradients and layouts
that actually look professional. Instantly.
